name: 音视频同步分析
description: Detects mismatches between audio and visual elements in video to identify AI-generated or manipulated content.
useCase: Identifying AI-generated videos through audio-visual synchronization analysis
mechanism: Analyzes the temporal synchronization between audio signals and visual content, including speech-lip correlation, environmental sound-scene consistency, and audio-visual event timing. AI-generated videos often have subtle desynchronization between audio and visual channels.
source: Chugh et al. (2020) - Not Made for Each Other — Audio-Visual Dissonance-based Deepfake Detection, ACM Multimedia
algorithm: Cross-modal Temporal Alignment + Audio Spectrogram Analysis + Visual Event Detection
parameters: Audio sample rate: 16kHz, Video FPS: native, Alignment window: 100ms, Features: MFCC + visual motion energy
strengths:
• Leverages cross-modal information for robust detection
• Effective against visually convincing fakes
• Can detect audio splicing and dubbing
• Works on various video types
limitations:
• Requires videos with meaningful audio content
• Less effective on music videos or ambient sound
• Needs sufficient video duration for reliable analysis
• Audio post-processing can mask artifacts

references.title: Chugh, K. et al. (2020). Not Made for Each Other — Audio-Visual Dissonance-based Deepfake Detection. ACM Multimedia.
